notes.title: Patch notes 09/12/2023
notes.content:
[list][*] Updated the following features of "Bullet Hell" mode:
[list][*] The Heal Gauge will not refill automatically and will refill when your attacks connect
[*] Enemy HP increased
[*] EXP received increased
[*] Mode can now be enabled/disabled at any time during gameplay[/list]
[*] Improved dash
  [list][*] Dash is no longer interrupted upon getting hit[/list]
[*] Added updated "Character Silhouette" option
*This option was temporarily disabled in the last hotfix update

[*] Fixed an issue where some text in the launcher became garbled on Steam Deck[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 08/03/23
notes.content:
[list][*]Mystery Capsule
Added Mystery Capsule dispenser in the General Store.
*Purchasing a Mystery Capsule with in-game currency will give you one random item.

[*]Added "Character Silhouette" to graphics options
 This option will show an outline of all characters (including enemies) when they are behind an object obstructing view.
*This is an experimental feature.

[*]Added Turbo Mode
We replaced Bullet Hell Plus with Turbo Mode in the launcher.
Turbo Mode increases the game speed by 25% and can be turned on/off separately from the Bullet Hell option.
If both Bullet Hell and Turbo Mode are enabled, the experience will be equivalent to Bullet Hell Plus. [/list]

Build ID: 11844555

tags.feature: Added Mystery Capsule dispenser in the General Store.

notes.title: Patch notes 07/21/23
notes.content:
[list][*] Added new higher difficulty options (Bullet Hell) accessible from the launcher.
[list][*] Bullet Hell
Greatly increases the number, speed, and damage of enemy projectiles.
[*] Bullet Hell Plus
In addition to the above changes, increases the game speed by 25%.[/list]
[*] Improved dash
Increased rate at which dash can be used.

[*] Reduced recovery after knockdown
Reduced time to recovery after taking a knockdown hit.[/list]

Build ID: 11747134

notes.title: Patch notes 07/14/23
notes.content:
[list][*] Updated default launch behavior to boot the configuration app. Players can disable this default behavior by unchecking the "Display Launcher on Startup" box in the launcher.[/list]

This update does not affect default launch behavior on Steam Deck, which will continue to boot the game by default.
